# FDG7023

> DO NOT disclose security-sensitive information in exception messages.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 7.2.1 Error Message Design.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
